nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spending allowances.
Public address used as the bot/recipient address checked inside _transfer.
Public address treated as the blacklisted/source address exempted from the max transfer check.
Private total supply variable initialised to 1,000,000,000,000 * 10**18.
Public maximum amount (700,000,000 * 10**18) allowed when transferring to the bot address.
Private owner address inherited from Ownable, gating all onlyOwner functions.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used throughout the contract.
onlyOwner setter that assigns _tBotAddress.
onlyOwner setter that assigns _tBlackAddress.
onlyOwner function that mints tokens by increasing _tTotal and the caller balance.
onlyOwner function that scales and stores the max transfer threshold _maxBlack.
Internal transfer routine that validates addresses, enforces the black/bot limit and moves balances.
ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
ERC20 transferFrom entry point that moves tokens then decreases the spender allowance.
ERC20 approve entry point delegating to _approve for the caller.
Private allowance writer validating zero addresses and emitting Approval.
Context helper returning msg.sender as a payable address.
BUNI constructor that credits the whole supply to the deployer and emits Transfer.
Address library helper sending ETH with a low-level call to an arbitrary recipient.
Address library private helper performing an arbitrary low-level call with value.
Ownable modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender() before executing the body.
onlyOwner function emitting OwnershipTransferred to the zero address.
onlyOwner function replacing _owner with a new account after a zero-address check.
Low-level call recipient.call{value: amount}("") that forwards all gas to an external address.
Low-level call target.call{value: weiValue}(data) executing arbitrary calldata on an external target.
sender address parameter of _transfer/transferFrom used as the balance debit key.
recipient address parameter of _transfer/transferFrom used as the balance credit key.
amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom used in SafeMath balance arithmetic.
blackListAddress parameter of setBlackListBot.
blackAddress parameter of setBlackAddress.
maxTxBlackPercent parameter of setMaxTxBlack multiplied by 10**18.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership written into _owner.
Local variable in the Ownable constructor holding _msgSender() before writing _owner.

edges.reason: _msgSender reads msg.sender and returns it.
The BUNI constructor uses _msgSender() to determine the initial holder.
The constructor sets _owner from the deployer address, establishing the onlyOwner authority.
The constructor credits _tTotal to the deployer balance in _balances.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against the stored owner.
onlyOwner reads _owner to decide whether the caller is authorised.
setBlackListBot execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBlackAddress execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setFeeTotal (mint) execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxTxBlack execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBlackListBot writes the caller supplied address into _tBotAddress.
setBlackAddress writes the caller supplied address into _tBlackAddress.
setMaxTxBlack stores maxTxBlackPercent * 10**18 into _maxBlack.
setFeeTotal increases the supply _tTotal using SafeMath.add.
setFeeTotal mints the new amount into the caller balance in _balances.
setFeeTotal checks _msgSender against the zero address and credits it.
transfer forwards its arguments to the internal _transfer routine.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender argument of _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _transfer(sender, recipient, amount).
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance through _approve.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] to subtract the spent amount.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_approve writes the granted amount into _allowances.
_transfer updates _balances for both sender and recipient.
_transfer reads the sender and recipient balances before SafeMath arithmetic.
_transfer compares the recipient against _tBotAddress.
_transfer compares the sender against _tBlackAddress.
_transfer enforces the amount < _maxBlack requirement for bot transfers.
The amount parameter feeds SafeMath.sub/add on balances inside _transfer.
The sender parameter indexes the debited balance entry.
The recipient parameter indexes the credited balance entry.
blackListAddress parameter flows into _tBotAddress in setBlackListBot.
blackAddress parameter flows into _tBlackAddress in setBlackAddress.
maxTxBlackPercent is multiplied by 10**18 before being stored in _maxBlack.
newOwner parameter is validated and stored by transferOwnership.
The local msgSender value is written into _owner by the constructor.
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership reads _owner to emit the ownership transfer event.
sendValue forwards ETH through recipient.call{value: amount}("") handing control to an external address.
The low-level call executes before accounting settles, letting a malicious recipient re-enter balance logic.
_functionCallWithValue performs target.call{value: weiValue}(data) with arbitrary calldata and value.
An arbitrary external call can re-enter allowance dependent logic such as transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists to index _balances inside _transfer and carries no independent state.
The recipient parameter is only used as the credit key inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is consumed by the SafeMath balance arithmetic of _transfer.
blackListAddress is a pure input assigned to _tBotAddress and has no behaviour of its own.
blackAddress is a pure input assigned to _tBlackAddress and has no behaviour of its own.
maxTxBlackPercent is only meaningful as the multiplier that produces _maxBlack.
newOwner is only validated and stored by transferOwnership.
The constructor local msgSender is simply the cached result of _msgSender().
